Live C1/C2 on books.toscrape.com: default 6 pages with /index.html collapsed into / (collapsed 1, duplicateContent 0, no step for it); with the option off it is fetched, recorded duplicate with a duplicate_content event and the seed's hash 9fdd63da (duplicateContent 1), /pages 5 vs /pages?includeDuplicates=true 6 with markdown null. Known leftover: a content-hash duplicate still costs its fetch and a page of maxPages. Tests: canonicalize, frontier, orchestrator, api app and crawlLifecycle, contracts firecrawl.

3d360be (feature cb8ac92): crawlEntireDomain (default false) keeps seed-host links inside the seed's path subtree (directory, a file's directory, or the path plus /; a seed redirect adds the final URL's subtree), subtree_denied otherwise; true follows the whole host; /fc maps allowBackwardLinks too. Live D1/D2 on docs.python.org/3/tutorial/ (10 pages each): default 10 pages all under /3/tutorial/ (subtreeDenied 168, seed event 15); true 8 of 10 pages outside it (subtreeDenied 0). Known leftovers: a directory convention where Firecrawl tests a path prefix; tasks stored before the option resume with the whole host; the w2l crawl CLI keeps the whole host and has no flag. Tests: frontier.test.ts, api app.test.ts, files.test.ts, firecrawl.test.ts.
